'''The Abidan and the Way''' is the order that guards the worlds of the Willverse, the structure those worlds hang from, and the powers that contest both.

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[The Way]] is a force that provides stability and order to worlds, attempting to force order out of the chaos caused by colliding worlds. It governs the proper flow of time and can be used to reinforce structures for stability, though a [[spatial rift]] exists as a slit in [[Way{{!}}the Way]]. The flows of order beneath reality are referred to as [[Way{{!}}the Way]] Between [[Worlds]], which can be tapped into to open a [[Celestial lenses{{!}}celestial lens]] or used for traveling messages. Reality exists in cycles or versions known as [[Iterations]], which can be rewound to a pristine condition. 

The [[Abidan]] were created in their birthplace, [[Cradle]], to save the weak who stand against the strong. They collect and quarantine important worlds to serve as a last bastion against infinite chaos. The [[Abidan Court]] operates in the name of order among the worlds and includes members known as [[Judges]], who are granted autonomy when responding to temporal or spatial violations. The First Judge of the [[Abidan Court]] is [[Makiel]], who is also a white-armored, rat-faced messenger known as [[The Hound{{!}}the Hound]] whose will bends [[Fate]]. Other members include the Sixth Judge, [[Judge Suriel{{!}}Suriel]], a healer and [[The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix]] who possesses a [[sapphire]] [[steel]] weapon called the [[Razor]]. The [[Reaper Division]] is a branch of the [[Abidan]] created to preserve existence by removing threats and intervening where others cannot. 

Various entities stand against the stability of the [[Iterations]]. The [[Vroshir]] are a threat to the worlds under [[Abidan protection]], seeking to add worlds to their network; this group includes [[Mad King{{!}}the Mad King]], a [[Vroshir]] who hosts an entity capable of killing [[Judges]]. [[Dreadgods]] are major threats that watch the world, cause [[Bloodspawn{{!}}bloodspawn]] to spread, and are capable of executing clans. [[Dreadgod cults]] are groups that compete in the [[Uncrowned]] and are considered enemies to anyone.}}
